description: NHERI UC San Diego LHPOST6 Modular Testbed Building (MTB2) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Tara Hutchinson, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). A large-scale testbed building was designed and shake-down tested on the newly upgraded Large High Performance Outdoor Shake Table (LHPOST6) at the University of California at San Diego. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Shake table tests, building models, testbed model, lateral-force resisting system. Published 2024-10-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
